title: Tensor symmetry of the native etale Kunneth map
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions and flat-preserving etale inverse images. Given scheme maps p:W→X, q:W→Y, f:X→S, g:Y→S, c:W→S with p;f=c=q;g, and arbitrary derived sheaves E on X and K on Y, the canonical Kunneth map of [def-kun-kunneth-map] obeys κ(p,q;E,K);Rc*(swap(p*E,q*K)) = swap(Rf*E,Rg*K);κ(q,p;K,E). All braidings are the canonical derived tensor symmetries of [lem-kun-tensor-sym]. No pullback or properness assumption is needed.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction before a trace; the coordinate triangle computation before applying its scalar trace

proof.text: Transpose the defining Kunneth map along Lc* ⊣ Rc*. The source-library pullback-compositor tensor equation identifies this transpose with the tensor comparison for c followed by the tensor of two maps: the compositor to Lp*Lf*Rf*E followed by Lp* of the f counit, and the analogous map for q,g,K. Use interchange to put both counits in separate factors and cancel the q,g compositor with its inverse. This is the proved private kunneth_transpose calculation.

The source-library theorem leftDerivedUpperStar_map_braiding_hom_comp_tensorComparison says that this tensor comparison commutes with the canonical braiding. Naturality of braiding with respect to the two mixed-counit maps gives the two transposes. Adjunction injectivity gives the claimed equality.

lean.statement:
theorem kunnethMap_tensorSymmetry {S X Y W : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : W ⟶ X) (q : W ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (c : W ⟶ S)
    (hp : p ≫ f = c) (hq : q ≫ g = c)
    (E : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology C))
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology C)) :
    kunnethMap C p q f g c hp hq E K ≫
        (lowerStar C c).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          (supportedTensorSwapIso C W
            ((upperStar C p).leftDerivedFunctor.obj E)
              ((upperStar C q).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).hom =
      (supportedTensorSwapIso C S
        ((lowerStar C f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E)
          ((lowerStar C g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K)).hom ≫
        kunnethMap C q p g f c hq hp K E
